annotations.title: Draft a survey from a study's interviews

description: Qual-first design: drafts a survey GROUNDED in the study's completed interviews — the recurring claims become measurable questions, the tensions become the choices, in the interviewees' own words. Replaces the study's current questions with the draft (nothing fields until publish). Needs at least one completed interview (see prism_interviews_list). An optional steer biases the instrument ('focus on pricing'). Runs generation against inference credit. May return `needs_confirmation`.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
